title: Applications are offered as available while Company Portal is not deployed

messages.businessImpact: Users have nowhere to obtain the software offered to them, so self-service installs become service desk calls.
remediation: Deploy Company Portal as a required application to all users, or remove the available assignments.
messages.cannotSee: The Company Portal is recognised by its Microsoft Store identifier, or by the name Microsoft publishes it under where the application has none, so a renamed copy packaged some other way reads as not having one. Whether the Windows devices in question can reach the store at all is outside what this tool sees.
